Execute a sequence of multiple actions (click, type, click) and verify all succeed with correct indices

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"always\"}}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let _item_actionsArray_0 = try Crawlberg.pageActionFromJson("{\"selector\":\"#open\",\"type\":\"click\"}")
let _item_actionsArray_1 = try Crawlberg.pageActionFromJson("{\"selector\":\"#field\",\"text\":\"test_data\",\"type\":\"type\"}")
let _item_actionsArray_2 = try Crawlberg.pageActionFromJson("{\"selector\":\"#submit\",\"type\":\"click\"}")
let actionsArray = [_item_actionsArray_0, _item_actionsArray_1, _item_actionsArray_2]
let result = try await Crawlberg.interact(engine: engineObj, url: url, actions: actionsArray)
debugPrint(result.actionResults()[0].actionIndex())
debugPrint(result.actionResults()[0].actionType())
debugPrint(result.actionResults()[0].success())
debugPrint(result.actionResults()[1].actionIndex())
debugPrint(result.actionResults()[1].actionType())
debugPrint(result.actionResults()[1].success())
debugPrint(result.actionResults()[2].actionIndex())
debugPrint(result.actionResults()[2].actionType())
debugPrint(result.actionResults()[2].success())
```
